articles.summary: Business of Home is the leading business media brand for the home industry, delivering essential news, analysis and insights for interior designers and home furnishings professionals. Since launching in 2009, it has served as a trusted daily resource, with offerings that include a robust digital newsroom, newsletters, podcasts, a quarterly magazine, the industry’s largest job board, business workshops, and a membership community for the entrepreneurs, executives and creatives shaping the sector.
articles.title: Business of Home

articles.summary: Since its inception 20 years ago, Domino has served as the destination for design with a distinct point of view and a story to tell. Through the lens of pros, influencers, and creative entrepreneurs, Domino reveals how the most stylish spaces come together, from aha moments of inspiration to the brass tacks of sourcing. We celebrate playfulness, self-expression, the art of mixing high and low, and the freedom to break the rules—or make your own.
articles.title: Domino

articles.summary: Dwell’s mission is simple. We champion home design that improves people’s lives. We feature new ideas about what a home can and should be, cover the topics shaping contemporary design, offer expert advice for making your own space a better place to live, and recommend the best products out there—from furniture to windows.
articles.title: Dwell
